thread:
Maya: FYI AcmeHealth asked for a quantization fallback + cache guidance for long-context RAG. Theyre worried about QoR loss after 8k tokens. Need to decide next-sprint priority.

Liam: +1 this is a customer blocker. My priority ranking: 1) eval-triggered alerts (fast win), 2) cache/prefix heuristics (medium), 3) quant-fallback plumbing (big).

Neha: Alerts first. Minimal path: ingest customer eval set, compute quality deltas, emit alerts to #ops and webhook. Can ship as a feature flag.

Samir: Quant fallback needs routing + variant compatibility checks. Prototype estimate: 2w dev + 1w integration testing. Production hardening another 2w.

Elen: From CS: AcmeHealth needs fallback guarantees before they commit to Dedicated. Maybe offer an "opt-in verified pairs" MVP to reduce scope and risk.

Maya: Proposed MVP scope: MUST: eval-triggered alerts integrated with ops alerts and slack. SHOULD: lightweight KV/prefix cache heuristics (tweak TTLs, hot-key detection). COULD: opt-in quant-fallback for verified model pairs. Acceptance gates: a) alert false-positive rate < 10% on validation set, b) pass AcmeHealth sample acceptance tests, c) documented rollback runbook + SLOs.

Liam: Can we parallelize? Ship alerts in sprint. Start quant prototype with a single eng pair as a separate track.

Samir: I'll pair with Neha for the prototype. Plan: routing shim + health probe + canary. Allocating ~20% this sprint, then 50% next sprint for validation.

Neha: I'll own eval triggers. I need ~50 labeled prompts from AcmeHealth to calibrate thresholds. Initial rule example: 
```
rule: eval_drop
metric: answer_f1
threshold: -6% relative
window: 1h
notify: #ops
```

Maya: @Samir @Neha sync with @Elen on acceptance tests and compliance items. Also need quick cost delta estimate for fallback spin-ups and per-token overhead.

Elen: I'll ask AcmeHealth for labeled prompts and whether they expect on-prem fallback vs hosted-only. Looping in finance for quick unit-costs.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created canary workspace for quant-proto on 2025-11-06T14:00Z (ticket RD-1983).

Liam: Sprint decision: ship eval-triggered alerts as the MVP slice. Kick off quant prototype (Samir+Neha) in parallel. Maya to write acceptance criteria and link product PR by EOD Friday.

Maya: I'll post the acceptance doc in #product and ping reviewers. Action items: 1) Neha - list required eval signals, 2) Samir - prototype routing interface sketch, 3) Elen - timeline for customer prompt delivery. Thanks all.
